rule: IAM-A(cell) = H(eps) / (P_cell * H(eps0)); P_cell = H(eps_healthy) / H(eps0) for healthy cells of that type, measured on the SAME read-level pipeline and frozen

neutrophils.source: Loyfer 2023 blood granulocytes GSM5652313/14/15, .pat files (first 60 MB each), copy error uncorrected (no sequence in .pat)
neutrophils.definition_of_P: per donor: H(mean eps of the other donors) / H(eps0); P = mean of the 3

pipeline_note: P is valid only for the pipeline it was measured on; any other read-level pipeline needs its own P from healthy cells of the type
evidence: IAMA_FLOOR_COMPARISON.md: healthy 3/3 Normal on (c) vs 0/3 on the bare floor; bare floor reads 0.70-0.79 (ENCODE pipeline) vs 1.08-1.13 (Loyfer) for healthy blood
